instruction: How much money have I received from others on venmo this month so far?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the model has only lookup actions plus complete_task. The received total is modeled as a single amount object whose value is computed at runtime by summing the amounts of all transactions returned by venmo.show_transactions filtered with direction=received and min_created_at=2023-05-01T00:00:00 (paginate until an empty page). The answer is passed as the numeric `answer` of supervisor.complete_task, which must be the last action. Username for venmo login is the supervisor's email; password comes from show_account_passwords.
